sections: 7.11 file specifications and embedded file streams

sources.title: Application Note 002: Associated Files
sources.retrieval: web text, not the original PDF bytes

facts: EmbeddedFiles names map to file specifications; EF carries stream variants and RF pairs related filenames with streams.
The Size parameter measures decoded payload bytes; CheckSum is the legacy 16-byte MD5 field, not an authenticity guarantee.
Collections use the EmbeddedFiles tree for membership, with optional initial document, schema, view and sorting.
Associated-file authoring needs an AF link and AFRelationship; embedded payloads require a MIME subtype and supplied Params requires a modification date.
PDF/A-3 introduces further constraints; associated-file structures alone do not establish archival conformance.
limitations: Source facts do not establish implementation behavior or complete standards qualification.
Direct PDF retrieval of the association note returned HTTP 403; only the available web text and its digest are retained.
